_comment_temp: 'CPU Package' is the on-die DTS - the standard CPU temperature, and what HWMonitor calls Package. It is spiky. 'Core Average' is smoother; the ITE 'Temperature #N' sensors are board probes and are what Gigabyte Control Center shows.
_comment_fan: Fan #1 = CPU header (GCC 'CPU'), #2/#3 = System 1 and 2 (empty), #4 = System 3, #5 = CPU_OPT which on this build is the PUMP.
_comment_fun: Fun mode alternates second by second: real, joke, real, next joke. Toggle from the tray icon. Each frame is [big, small] and null keeps the REAL reading for that slot -- the defaults only touch the fan, so the temperature is never faked (a number in the big readout is drawn with a degree mark and reads as a believable temperature). The big field is 7-bit: over 127 displays as 127. The fan slot is 16-bit.
_comment_fan_low2_offset: The panel renders the fan value as two independent decimal fields and the last two digits come out +20 (mod 100), with no carry: sending 8008 shows 8028, sending 7996 shows 7916. The driver rolls them back so the number you ask for is the one displayed. null = send verbatim.
